blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 168 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 4, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: HLF & MRNA lead 168 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 46 Canadian and 122 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 4, 2026) found 168 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 46 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 29 of them new to the list this week. High Liner Foods Incorporated (HLF) leads with a +97% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 15 names.

In the U.S., 122 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 60 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +357% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 34 names.
